name: Euclidean Rhythm
credit: Euclidean rhythm E(X,Y) by blue hell (2012). Set X-1 and Y-1 one less than X and Y, X < Y; the variations hold eight presets. electro-music.org/forum/topic-55736.html

name: Clock Multiply
credit: Clock multiplier by iPassenger: ZeroCnt measures the clock period and drives x2/x3/x4 LFOs. Clock into ZeroCnt In; the output is wrong until the second pulse. electro-music.org/forum/topic-53307.html

name: Clock Shuffle
credit: Clock shuffler by iPassenger: divides the clock by 1-8 and shuffles the divided outputs over eight Mux outputs (after the 4MS RCD). electro-music.org/forum/topic-53308.html

name: Decade Counter
credit: 1-of-10 decade counter by iPassenger (after the Future Sound Systems DC1). Clock into Clk Input, reset into Rst Input. electro-music.org/forum/topic-49454.html

name: Variable Step Length Clock
credit: Programmable rhythmic clock divider by Rob Hordijk (2006): per-step lengths from 1/32 to 3/4 (see the step labels), synced to the bar. electro-music.org/forum/topic-11424.html

name: Gated Clock Trigger
credit: Trigger pattern from a level sequencer, Roland Kuit (Prog house techno part I, '6-Trigg1'): SeqLev steps above zero let the 1/16 clock through; the Constant shifts the density. Output: LevMult1.

name: Probability Trigger
credit: Random-pattern trigger with pattern selector, Roland Kuit ('5-with snare'): RndPattern -> CompLev -> Gate (AND with the clock); Sw4-1 picks one of three pattern Constants. Output: Gate1 Out1.

name: Hysteresis Switch
credit: Hysteresis switch by ik: turns a control signal (e.g. the pitch stick, into comp A) into an on/off gate with a +/- 'h window' threshold. electro-music.org/forum/topic-12959.html

name: One-and-Only-One Pulse
credit: After Rob Hordijk, G2 Synthesis Workshops - Sequencing. A trigger into Arm Clk arms it; the clock into Out Clk; Out Q gives exactly one clock-long pulse.

name: Circular Pattern Buffer
credit: After Rob Hordijk, G2 Synthesis Workshops - Sequencing (Circular1): an 8-step S&H loop; every 5th clock the LFO value replaces the oldest step. Use an odd divider with an even step count; Hordijk runs LfoA at 2.72 Hz. Output: KeyQuant.

name: Up-Down Slew
credit: Serge-style up/down slew limiter by Rob Hordijk: separate rise and fall speeds; also a filter/distortion on audio. electro-music.org/forum/topic-11519.html

name: Linear Portamento
credit: Constant-time linear portamento with Auto/Normal/Off switch, by Chet (2005). Output: X-Fade1 (to an oscillator Pitch). electro-music.org/forum/topic-7009.html

name: Random No Repeat
credit: Quantized random LFO that never repeats a note, by Loz with blue hell's revision (2007). electro-music.org/forum/topic-17477.html

name: LFSR Random
credit: Self-starting LFSR pseudo-random generator (XNOR) with weighted outputs, by blue hell (2008). Output: Mix4-1B1. electro-music.org/forum/topic-23275.html

name: Crossover 2-Band
credit: 2-band crossover (bands sum to the exact input), designed by Rob Hordijk, patched by jamos. Input into LP In; outputs LP and HP. electro-music.org/forum/topic-5218.html

name: Crossover 3-Band
credit: 3-band crossover, designed by Rob Hordijk, patched by jamos. electro-music.org/forum/topic-5218.html

name: Crossover 4-Band
credit: 4-band crossover, designed by Rob Hordijk, patched by jamos. electro-music.org/forum/topic-5218.html

name: Spectrum Tilt
credit: Stereo one-knob spectral tilt filter by Rob Hordijk. electro-music.org/forum/topic-7237.html

name: Chamberlin SVF
credit: DIY 12 dB Chamberlin state-variable filter by Tim Kleinert (2015): AUDIO IN, CUTOFF IN, RESO IN; OUTPUT selects LP/BP/HP/BR. electro-music.org/forum/topic-64858.html

name: Formant Filter
credit: After Rob Hordijk, G2 Synthesis Workshops - Filters (FormantFilter): three band-passes mixed, with a dry/wet crossfade. Input into FltStatic1 In; output X-Fade.

name: Ladder 24dB VC Reso
credit: After Rob Hordijk, G2 Synthesis Workshops - Resonant filters (Basic24dB2): four 6 dB poles with an inverted resonance loop, an integrator for warmth and a VC resonance. Input into Input In1; output FltLP4.

name: Integrator 6dB LP
credit: After Rob Hordijk, G2 Synthesis Workshops - Filters: a crossfader fed back into itself is a one-knob 6 dB lowpass (Mix sets the cutoff). Input into In1.

name: Harmonic Distortion
credit: Odd/even harmonic distorter by Rob Hordijk (2005): a biased VCA fed with x^2. Input into Input In; output Output. electro-music.org/forum/topic-5896.html

name: Klang Modulator
credit: Versatile ring modulator 'Klanglabor' modelled by Rob Hordijk (2005); the eight variations hold the labelled settings. Inputs A and B; output Output. electro-music.org/forum/topic-5487.html

name: Soft Clipper
credit: Soft clipper with drive and tone by Rob Hordijk (2006). Input into SoftClip; output Output. electro-music.org/forum/topic-14506.html

name: Compressor Env Choice
credit: DIY compressor with a choice of six envelope followers, by Fozzie (2006). Input via INPUT; output ComprOut. electro-music.org/forum/topic-12318.html

name: Vactrol LPG
credit: Vactrol low-pass gate after the Doepfer A-101-2, by John W. Thompson (2023): an AD envelope with a vactrol curve on filter cutoff and amplitude. electro-music.org/forum/topic-73754.html

name: Noise Kick
credit: Old-school kick by Roland Kuit ('1a-Old School Kick'): noise into a fully resonant FltClassic, EnvD sweeps the pitch and is the VCA. Trigger into EnvD1 Trig; output EnvD1 Out.

name: Formant Snare
credit: Formant snare by Roland Kuit ('5b-Formant Snare'): noise through three static filters. Trigger into EnvD1 Trig; output EnvD1 Out.

name: FM Hi-Hat
credit: Cross-FM hi-hat by Roland Kuit ('3-Kick&Hihats'). Trigger into OscShpB1 Sync (linked to EnvD2 Trig); output EnvD2 Out.

name: Metal Hi-Hat Random Decay
credit: MetNoise hi-hat whose decay and colour follow a random pattern, by Roland Kuit ('4-more Hihat control'). Clock/sync into RndPattern, trigger into ModAHD1 Trig; output ModAHD1.

name: Punch Kick
credit: Kick with pitch envelope, square sub and saturation, by Roland Kuit ('YezDrumz', 2004). Trigger into P env Trig; output Saturate.

name: Tom 2-Osc
credit: Two-sine tom with pitch AHD and sine/saw blend, by Roland Kuit ('YezDrumz', 2004). Trigger into A AHD Trig; output A AHD.

name: Resonant Ping
credit: After Jeff Clark, Nord Modular book, fig. 3.3: a short pulse pings a resonant band-pass (tuned drum/tom; key tracked). Trigger into Pulse In; output FltMulti BP. Tune Pulse Time (Clark: 3.7 ms), Freq and Res by ear.

name: Pseudo Stereo
credit: Pseudo-stereo allpass widener by Tim Kleinert (2005): original and allpassed copy panned hard L/R (not mono compatible). electro-music.org/forum/topic-8487.html

name: Stereo Feedback Delay
credit: Stereo feedback delay from Roland Kuit's 'YezDrumz' (2004), FX area.

name: Tap Tempo Delay
credit: Tap-tempo delay (ZeroCnt + LFO version) by Tim Kleinert (2007). electro-music.org/forum/topic-17580.html

name: Soft-Capture Looper
credit: After Rob Hordijk, G2 Synthesis Workshops - Loopers (MonoLoop): Capture fades the input into a recirculating delay without clicks. Input into X-Fade In2; output X-Fade.

name: Simple Sampler
credit: Volatile 2.7 s sampler with scrub and start point (SimpleSample3) by Tim Kleinert. Patch Settings > Audio In to pick the input; SAMPLE captures, PLAYBAK/START set position. Audio is lost on patch change. electro-music.org/forum/topic-18566.html

name: Elastic Audio
credit: Elastic-audio building block by Tim Kleinert (2007): captures 2 s and plays it back with independent time and pitch, Fixed/Intelli grain MODE, GRAIN size. electro-music.org/forum/topic-21547.html

name: 16ths Slicer
credit: 16ths slicer by Tim Kleinert (2008): waits for MIDI clock, captures one 4/4 bar and plays any of its 16 slices. Inputs: slice in (0-15), trig in. Monophonic; see the original textpad. electro-music.org/forum/topic-26364.html

name: Sampling Oscillator
credit: Crude 16-step waveform sampler by Tim Kleinert: a DIY saw writes the input into a SeqNote, giving a sampled single-cycle oscillator. electro-music.org/forum/topic-19156.html

name: Stretch Freezer
credit: Stretch/freeze FX by Tim Kleinert (2004, v2): an 8-tap delay read out by a saw-swept mux, plus a cloud delay and freeze point. electro-music.org/forum/topic-1913.html

name: Audio Freeze
credit: Audio Freeze by Tim Kleinert (2006): time-stretches live audio to a halt (about 13 s), with T-STRETCH freq/jitter and HP/LP. electro-music.org/forum/topic-13231.html

name: Reverse Delay
credit: Reversed slapback delay by Tim Kleinert (2006); the SENS noise gate detects onsets. electro-music.org/forum/topic-13274.html

name: Reversi
credit: Reversi by Tim Kleinert (2009): clock-synced, chops the input into beats and plays each backwards one beat later. electro-music.org/forum/topic-35212.html

name: Random Reorder
credit: Random reorder by Tim Kleinert (2009): randomly reorders the 16ths of a clock-synced 4/4 input. Don't go below 92 BPM. electro-music.org/forum/topic-35246.html

name: Loop Reorder 16
credit: LoopReOrder16 by Tim Kleinert (2007): reorders the 16ths of a live 4/4 loop with a slice/mute sequencer (min. 92 BPM). electro-music.org/forum/topic-17372.html

name: 128-Word RAM
credit: Virtual 128-word RAM built on delays, by Tim Kleinert (bug-fixed by stk/Cedric): address 0..63.5 in 0.5 steps, STORE trigger. Not saved with the patch. electro-music.org/forum/topic-35012.html

name: 4-Point Interpolation
credit: 4-point linear interpolation by Tim Kleinert (2010): upsamples a control-rate signal to audio rate, e.g. for clean sample/grain pointers. electro-music.org/forum/topic-41210.html

name: Mono Elastic Synth
credit: MonoLasticSynt by Tim Kleinert (2007): mono 'intelligent elastic audio' sampler, zero-crossing based grains (full patch, Voice area). electro-music.org/forum/topic-21432.html

name: Deluxe Looper
credit: Deluxe Looper by Tim Kleinert (2006): MIDI-synced one-bar loop capture with elastic playback (speed, direction, T-STRETCH, scrub). Don't use below 92 BPM. electro-music.org/forum/topic-13234.html

name: Clock Gate Pulse Width
credit: Clock gate with tempo-proof duty cycle (Clock Gate PW2c) by Varice J. Mire (2012): set the duty cycle with 'Gate PW'. electro-music.org/forum/topic-53168.html

name: Up-Down Preset Counter
credit: Up/down counter with preset, step size, direction and limits, by Tim Kleinert and Howard Moscovitz. Output: OUTPUT. electro-music.org/forum/topic-6956.html

name: Up-Down Counter
credit: DSP-cheap up/down counter by Tim Kleinert with 3phase's limits: separate UP/DOWN amounts and a START value. electro-music.org/forum/topic-18505.html

name: Pattern Rotator
credit: Pattern rotator by Spandex: rotates a SeqNote pattern by N 16ths through a shift register (paste into the input sequence, read the output sequence). electro-music.org/forum/topic-45727.html

name: Zero-Cross Trigger
credit: Zero-crossing trigger by 3phase (VirusLabs). electro-music.org/forum/topic-7278.html

name: Trigger Buffer
credit: Trigger buffer by 3phase (VirusLabs). electro-music.org/forum/topic-7278.html

name: Knob Move Trigger
credit: Gives a trigger whenever a knob (the ConstSwT) moves, by 3phase (after Afro88). electro-music.org/forum/topic-6044.html

name: Trigger to CV
credit: Trigger to CV by Babyhead (2012): several triggers each select their own CV level (e.g. 4 tom pitches from one oscillator). electro-music.org/forum/topic-52120.html

name: Pattern Evolver
credit: Random-pattern clock with pattern selector and a slow sequencer that changes the pattern every bar, by Roland Kuit ('MoogThing'). Output: RndPattern.

name: Trigger + Accent
credit: Level-sequencer trigger pattern with accent VCA, by Roland Kuit ('7-Trigg1b'). Triggers: LevMult1; audio through LevMult2 gets the accent.

name: Quadrature LFO
credit: Quadrature LFO by ian-s: Schmitt-trigger triangle oscillator with four triangles 90 degrees apart. electro-music.org/forum/topic-8576.html

name: Glissando Gizmo
credit: Glissando generator by Howard Moscovitz: Step Size, Hi and Low Limit. electro-music.org/forum/topic-6174.html

name: Random Ramp
credit: Random up/down ramps by Dave Peck: Master rate, Vary slope, Flip rate and probability; output Rand Ramp. electro-music.org/forum/topic-8949.html

name: Stepped Glide Sequence
credit: Glide on the sequencer steps, then sampled on the 1/16 clock, by Roland Kuit ('13-RMPuseBassSeq'). Output: S&H1.

name: X-Mux Tracking Generator
credit: Matrix-6 style tracking generator with eight Constants on an X-Mux, by Dave Peck. electro-music.org/forum/topic-5184.html

name: Modulo N
credit: Modulo-n of a note value by blue hell: transpose, NoteQuant n, subtract (see the original notes). electro-music.org/forum/topic-5302.html

name: Octave Switch 8
credit: Minimoog-style 8-position octave switch by jamos. electro-music.org/forum/topic-74991.html

name: Octave Switch 4
credit: Minimoog-style 4-position octave switch by jamos. electro-music.org/forum/topic-74991.html

name: Tap Tempo Delay Control
credit: Non-volatile tap tempo plus smoothed manual delay time (control for a 1 s delay) by Tim Kleinert (2015). Output: OUTPUT (bipolar time). electro-music.org/forum/topic-65027.html

name: Pitch Detector
credit: Improved pitch detector by Tim Kleinert (2012): pitch plus periodic/unperiodic gate and transition outputs. electro-music.org/forum/topic-52784.html

name: Differentiator Z-1
credit: Per-sample differentiator and one-sample (z-1) delay from two mixers, by Tim Kleinert. Keep the lower mixer below the upper one (compile order). electro-music.org/forum/topic-64966.html

name: Triangle to Sine
credit: Triangle-to-sine shaper y = x(2-|x|) by ian-s; ShpStatic (mode 2) does the same, per selvmarcus. electro-music.org/forum/topic-11892.html

name: Mux Mode Filter
credit: Multimode filter with one knob sweeping LP-BP-HP-Notch, by Dave Peck. electro-music.org/forum/topic-8530.html

name: MorPhilter
credit: Morphing filter by Tim Kleinert: 24 dB LP to 12/12 dB BP to 24 dB HP. electro-music.org/forum/topic-11511.html

name: Filthy Filter
credit: NordFilter with odd-harmonic distorted resonance via Res Mod, by Tim Kleinert. Keep GC off and LP mode. electro-music.org/forum/topic-11511.html

name: Classic Filter Saturation
credit: Controlled saturation of FltClassic: boost 12 dB before, reduce 6 dB after, by Tim Kleinert (2012). electro-music.org/forum/topic-55007.html

name: Chamberlin 24dB
credit: Dual-stage 24 dB multimode Chamberlin filter with resonance gain compensation, by Tim Kleinert (2015). electro-music.org/forum/topic-64858.html

name: Noise Colours
credit: Five noise filters by Rob Hordijk: bell-shaped distribution, classic pink, pink-blue morph, pink/white booster, resonant band. electro-music.org/forum/topic-8238.html

name: Pink Noise
credit: Pink noise approximation (two noise sources + EqPeak) by Varice J. Mire (2012). electro-music.org/forum/topic-8238.html

name: Sine Saturation
credit: Saturator using the -90..+90 degree part of a sine (OscPM at 0 Hz), DRIVE/BIAS/MAKEUP, by Tim Kleinert. electro-music.org/forum/topic-17935.html

name: Audio Up-Down Slew
credit: Audio-rate up/down slew by Tim Kleinert: waveshaping and tone control. electro-music.org/forum/topic-18525.html

name: Transient Shaper
credit: Transient shaper by Afrokid: shapes the attack of stabs and drums (Threshold, Shape, Ratio, PostGain). electro-music.org/forum/topic-6002.html

name: X-Mux Waveshaper
credit: Lo-fi waveshaper: audio drives an X-Mux of eight Constants, by Dave Peck. electro-music.org/forum/topic-5184.html

name: Phase Distortion FX
credit: Stereo phase-distortion FX by Tim Kleinert (2016): phase-modulates the input with a filtered copy of itself; the dummy delays work around a readout bug. electro-music.org/forum/topic-65736.html

name: Stereo Drive Dry-Wet
credit: Stereo saturation with Drive and dry/dist crossfade, by Roland Kuit ('Cyclane', FX area).

name: Phaser Pos-Neg Feedback
credit: Phaser whose one Feedback knob goes from negative to positive feedback, by Dave Peck. electro-music.org/forum/topic-8952.html

name: 8-Tap Delay
credit: Eight modulatable taps at 48 kHz from one DelayQuad (2.7 s), by Tim Kleinert. electro-music.org/forum/topic-31680.html

name: Strings Resonator
credit: Stereo synthi-strings resonator (MN3011 tap ratios) by Rob Hordijk. electro-music.org/forum/topic-5680.html

name: Revox A77 Echo
credit: Revox A77 ping-pong tape echo with saturation, head gap, emphasis, optional noise/EQ/distortion, by Rob Hordijk. electro-music.org/forum/topic-7442.html

name: Pseudo Stereo 2
credit: Comb-filter mono-to-stereo, 100% mono compatible, by Tim Kleinert. electro-music.org/forum/topic-8663.html

name: Harmonic Disperser
credit: Pitch-tracking delay that pans even and odd harmonics left and right (PseudoStereo3), by Tim Kleinert. electro-music.org/forum/topic-8704.html

name: Swept Band Delay
credit: Stereo LP/HP-filtered delays with LFO/random sweep and compressor, by Roland Kuit ('Cyclane', FX area).

name: Plucked String
credit: Plucked string with controllable pluck and pickup points, by Chet: three OscStrings tracking one pitch. electro-music.org/forum/topic-11550.html

name: Folded Sync
credit: Smooth 'hard sync' without a second oscillator: a biased wavefolder on a triangle, by jamos. electro-music.org/forum/topic-69374.html

name: Triangle Ring-Mod Bass
credit: Three triangle oscillators ring-modulated into a resonant filter, by Roland Kuit ('TriBazz2'). Pitch into Master, trigger into the oscillators' Sync.

name: Closed-Open Hi-Hats
credit: Closed and open MetNoise hi-hats with decay and colour controls, by Roland Kuit ('YezDrumz', 2004). Triggers into each ModAHD Trig.
